messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat
parts:
Duplicated rows should be handled in ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat function. 

Please check the manual from p35. Especially, I suggest to check whether your input and output for ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat and input for dataProcess has the same columns as in manual.

Hope to be helpful.

Best,
- Meena
